message.content: The regression run still found failures, so I’m fixing the tokenizer’s tag/attribute parsing and will rerun tests before submitting.

function.name: bash
function.arguments:
{"command":"python - <<'PY'
p='/app/filter.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("TOKEN = re.compile(r'<!--.*?-->|<![^>]*>|<\\?[^>]*>|</?[A-Za-z][^>]*>', re.S)", "TOKEN = re.compile(r'<!--.*?-->|<![^>]*>|<\\?[^>]*>|</?[A-Za-z][^\\s/>]*(?:\\s+(?:\\\"[^\\\"]*\\\"|' + \"'[^']*'\" + r'|[^\\\"\\\' >])*)?\\s*/?>', re.S)")
s=s.replace("ATTR = re.compile(r'''([^\\s=/>]+)(?:\\s*=\\s*(?:\"([^\"]*)\"|'([^']*)'|([^\\s>]+)))?''')", "ATTR = re.compile(r'''([^\\s=/>]+)(?:\\s*=\\s*(?:\"([^\"]*)\"|'([^']*)'|([^\\s>]+)))?''')")
s=s.replace("        name, double, single, bare = a.groups()\n        value = double if double is not None else single if single is not None else bare\n        attrs.append((name, value))", "        name, double, single, bare = a.groups()\n        if '=' not in a.group(0) and name.lower() in {'script', 'alert', 'evil'}:\n            # Boolean attribute names may coincide with script text; retain as attributes only when structurally valid.\n            pass\n        value = double if double is not None else single if single is not None else bare\n        attrs.append((name, value))")
# Treat unsafe data URLs, including HTML payloads with literal angle brackets.
s=s.replace("    if value.startswith(('javascript:', 'vbscript:')):\n        return True", "    if value.startswith(('javascript:', 'vbscript:')):\n        return True\n    if value.startswith('data:text/html'):\n        return True")
# Permit HTMLParser to parse tag attributes robustly, preserving originals when clean.
start=s.index('def sanitize_tag(raw):')
end=s.index('\n\ndef sanitize(source):', start)
s=s[:start]+'''def sanitize_tag(raw):
    parsed = parse_tag(raw)
    if not parsed or raw.startswith(('<!--', '<!', '<?')):
        return raw
    closing, tag, attrs = parsed
    if closing:
        return raw
    safe = []
    changed = False
    for name, value in attrs:
        key = name.lower()
        if key.startswith('on') or key == 'srcdoc':
            changed = True
            continue
        if value is not None and key in URL_ATTRS and unsafe_url(value):
            changed = True
            continue
        if value is not None and key == 'style':
            cleaned = BAD_CSS.sub('', value)
            if cleaned != value:
                changed = True
                value = cleaned
        safe.append((name, value))
    if not changed:
        return raw
    self_closing = raw.rstrip().endswith('/>')
    result = ['<' + tag]
    for name, value in safe:
        result.append(' ' + name if value is None else ' ' + name + '="' + html.escape(value, quote=True) + '"')
    result.append('/>' if self_closing else '>')
    return ''.join(result)
''' + s[end:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
python -m py_compile /app/filter.py && python /tmp/test_filter.py 2>&1 | tail -45"}
